observations: Photo 0: Silver-and-black retro-styled mirrorless camera body with 'Nikon' logo and 'Z fc' text engraved on top plate, rear cap reads 'Nikon Z mount'.
Photo 1: Close-up of the same body showing 'Nikon' and 'Z fc' lettering again, plus a manual-focus lens with aperture ring marked in f-stops (f2-f16), no autofocus contacts visible.

Photo 2: Top-down view showing the camera, a battery labeled 'Nikon Rechargeable Li-ion Battery', a charger labeled 'Nikon Battery Charger', two rear lens caps marked 'Nikon', and a front lens cap marked 'TTArtisan APS-C 35mm f2.0'.
No Canon logo, Canon lens mount, or Canon packaging appears in any of the three photos.
No photo shows the camera powered on, a shutter count, or any image sample to verify function.

claims.evidence: Photo 0 and photo 1 clearly show 'Nikon' engraved on the body; photo 2 shows Nikon-branded battery and charger. No Canon marking appears anywhere.

claims.claim: Nikon Z fc is a retro-inspired, SLR-style mirrorless camera, 20.9MP APS-C.
claims.evidence: Body styling and 'Z fc' text in photos 0-1 match the described retro-SLR look, but the sensor megapixel count cannot be read or confirmed from any photo.

claims.claim: Implied working condition (not explicitly claimed, but usually assumed for a listed camera).
claims.evidence: No power-on shot, no sample image, no shutter-count screen shown in any of the 3 photos.

risks.risk: Listing text and brand label directly contradict the photographed item, a classic sign of a copy-pasted or mismatched ad template.
risks.proof: A fresh photo of the camera with a handwritten note/date and the seller's face or ID, matching the exact unit, to confirm this specific body is being sold.
risks.if_unproven: treat the whole listing as unreliable; do not price until contradiction is resolved

risks.risk: Lens bundled is a third-party manual-focus TTArtisan 35mm f2.0, not a Nikon kit zoom, which affects value versus a 'kit lens' expectation.
risks.proof: Photo of the lens mount markings and a shot of it attached and focusing on the camera.
risks.if_unproven: priced as body-only value since lens contribution is uncertain

risks.risk: Shutter count / sensor condition / functional state unknown.
risks.proof: Video of camera powering on, shutter firing, and a test shot or menu screen showing shutter count.
risks.if_unproven: priced as not confirmed working (worst case)

risks.risk: Possible grey-market or stolen unit, or stock photos lifted from another listing (watermark 'Oyibest Global Resources' suggests reused marketing images).
risks.proof: Proof of purchase/receipt or serial number photo matched to a live unboxing video.

proof_requests: A new photo/video taken today of this exact camera powered on, with a handwritten paper showing today's date and seller's name/phone visible beside it.
Confirmation of why the text says 'Canon' when every photo shows 'Nikon' branding — request a clear explanation or corrected listing.
Shutter count screen or test image shot through the lens.
Close-up of the serial number plate matched against any proof of purchase.
response.reason: The seller's own words assert the brand is Canon while every photo unambiguously shows Nikon branding, Nikon Z-mount markings, and Nikon battery/charger, a direct and material contradiction on the core identity of the item that signals a mismatched or recycled listing rather than a simple typo.
